label_assumption: All frames outside the intervals in merged_spans.csv are non-circling.
sampling: Every 128-row segment containing circling plus an equal number of segments without circling, sampled without replacement within each source video, seed 42.
split: Stratified random 80/20 train/test split of the sampled segments after sampling, random_state=42. Segments do not overlap.
validation: DLC2Action validation subset = test segments, used for logging only (no early stopping or model selection).
limitation: Neighboring segments and spans can occur in both splits; this is not an independent-event or new-video evaluation.
score_warning: Scores describe the balanced sampled dataset, not calibrated probabilities at full-video prevalence.
